# BMP 1.16.0

## Round focus

- compiler feature-detection helpers in the installed export header
- semantic `PURE`/`CONST_FN` annotations on suitable APIs
- analyzer and header-matrix smoke targets
- CI coverage for contract portability

## Highlights

This round is about making the contract layer less heuristic and more verifiable across GCC, Clang, and MSVC-oriented consumers.
